about_page.title: About Us
about_page.subtitle: A legacy of excellence in Vietnamese commercial law, built on integrity, expertise, and unwavering commitment to our clients.
about_page.history_title: From 2009 to today: built for Vietnam's next chapter
about_page.history_p1: BDLAW was founded in 2009 with a clear mission: to connect international legal standards with Vietnam's fast-moving business environment. What began as a focused commercial practice has matured into a firm trusted on complex cross-border work and high-stakes mandates.
about_page.history_p2: Our multidisciplinary lawyers combine deep local insight with global perspective—so clients can move forward with clarity, whether they are investing, restructuring, or resolving disputes.
about_page.stats_sub: A quick sense of our footprint—years in market, breadth of practices, and presence across Vietnam's two largest business hubs.
about_page.press_sub: We are regularly referenced in major international legal directories. Below you can feature cover images, rankings pages, or editorial pull-quotes from each publication.
about_page.matters_lead: Representative experience is often confidential. The patterns below reflect the types of mandates we handle for multinationals, sponsors, and major domestic groups—without naming clients or matters.
about_page.matters_tx_desc: M&A, joint ventures, restructurings, banking and finance, energy and infrastructure, and FDI structuring where Vietnam meets foreign capital and governance expectations.
about_page.matters_arb_desc: Counsel and advocacy in institutional and ad hoc arbitration, parallel court proceedings, and enforcement—where proceedings or counterparties span multiple jurisdictions.
about_page.matters_sector_desc: Advisory and contentious work in sectors under close regulatory scrutiny, where alignment with authorities, licensing logic, and reputational risk all matter.
about_page.split_lead: Clients come to us when the stakes are high and the path is not obvious. We structure advice so decision-makers can act with confidence.
about_page.split_b1: Senior-led teams on matters that matter—no unnecessary layers between you and the lawyers driving the file.
about_page.split_b2: One firm across Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, aligned on process, quality, and responsiveness.
about_page.split_b3: Practical solutions grounded in regulators' expectations, market practice, and what will stand up in negotiation or dispute.

careers_page.subtitle: Join a team of exceptional legal professionals shaping the future of commercial law in Vietnam.
careers_page.why_text: At BDLAW, we invest in our people. We offer a collaborative environment where junior lawyers work directly with senior partners on high-profile matters, gaining invaluable experience in cross-border transactions, international arbitration, and corporate advisory.
careers_page.cta_text: We're always looking for talented legal professionals. Send us your resume and we'll keep you in mind for future opportunities.
